parsed.rationale: Although both records carry is_sample_app=false in their context_flags, the second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits directly under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path segment. The decision rules treat any record under Examples/ or SampleApp/ as a sample-app restraint marker regardless of the flag value, and that marker dominates action signals. Lifting MetricRow.body from the sample app's DebugHUD into the production DebugPanel package would couple production code to demonstration semantics; the correct posture is to leave the duplication in place.
